role: indexed basic null hypothesis
notes: Asserts membership in its specified null parameter set; the family is fixed before observing data.

role: null parameter set for the indexed hypothesis
notes: May overlap other null sets and include nuisance parameters.

role: number of hypotheses in the fixed family
notes: Positive integer for the main rule; the empty-family convention returns no rejections.

role: indices of hypotheses true at the actual full parameter
notes: Not an observed input to the rejection procedure.

role: number of actual true hypotheses
notes: Zero gives an empty family-error event; otherwise used in the first-true-rejection proof.

role: measurable basic rejection set
notes: A subset of the fixed hypothesis indices depending on the observed data.

role: critical region for rejection of the indexed hypothesis
notes: An event in the sample space; distinct from the lower-case positive weight.

role: probability of at least one rejection of a true hypothesis
notes: Evaluated at each actual configuration rather than only the complete null.

role: chosen family significance level
notes: Between zero and one; distinct from the source critical-level function with subscript.

role: marginally valid obtained level or p-value
notes: The null inequality quantifies over the entire parameter including other hypotheses and nuisance values.

role: test statistic with large values favoring rejection
notes: Dependence across these statistics is unrestricted for ordinary and weighted Holm.

role: inclusive upper-tail supremum over the indexed null
notes: Nonincreasing measurable function used in Holm's original obtained-level construction.

role: raw obtained level in the ordinary sorted order
notes: Uses the unweighted obtained-level ordering; the weighted method instead tests the explicitly carried original index.

role: original index carried by the currently specified sorting order
notes: Ordinary ordering sorts obtained levels; the weighted method explicitly redefines its ordering by ratios.

role: hypothesis carried by the current sorting position
notes: The ordinary and weighted methods each specify their ordering before using the position.

role: ordinary Holm rejection set
notes: Only the passing prefix is rejected; stop at the first failed comparison.

role: fixed Bonferroni and unadjusted rejection sets
notes: Use the same family and individual obtained levels as the Holm comparison.

role: Holm adjusted level assigned to a ranked hypothesis
notes: The capped running maximum retains all previous stopping conditions.

role: secondary intersection hypothesis
notes: The stated secondary rejection policy rejects an intersection when any basic member is rejected.

role: scalar directional parameter and common null boundary
notes: The paired opposite-tail argument requires a boundary law present in both null sets.

role: all-details-nonrejection inverted candidate set
notes: The equality with Bonferroni concerns this specific confidence construction.

role: standard normal cumulative distribution function
notes: The exact normal-model power calculation uses this CDF and its quantiles.

role: ordered critical-level bin boundary
notes: Zero initial boundary followed by ten Holm thresholds for the source normal example.

role: CDF of an obtained level under a specified normal mean
notes: Defined with zero and one endpoint values in addition to its open-interval formula.

role: positive fixed hypothesis-priority weight
notes: Chosen before the observed levels; common rescaling changes no decision.

role: obtained level divided by its positive weight
notes: These ratios determine the weighted ordering.

role: ratio in the weighted sorted order
notes: Equal ratio blocks have whole-block decisions.

role: weight carried by the current weighted sorting position
notes: The remaining sum changes after each accepted rejection step.

role: total weight of the hypotheses remaining at step j
notes: Includes all still-present true hypotheses at the first true rejection.

role: fixed-weight Holm rejection set
notes: Does not universally dominate unweighted Holm.

role: sum of weights on the actual true-null indices
notes: Positive only in the nonempty true-null case; distinct from a sample-space critical region.

role: independence-based critical level with k hypotheses remaining
notes: Its family guarantee requires joint independence of the true obtained levels at each actual configuration.

role: normal-group observation counts and pooled residual degrees of freedom
notes: The treatment-control model permits unequal group sizes with a common variance.

role: pooled residual standard deviation
notes: The obtained levels are explicitly defined at zero scale as well.

role: Student statistic comparing treatment i with the common control
notes: Tests share their control and pooled variance; marginal calibration suffices.

role: Student cumulative distribution function with nu degrees of freedom
notes: Uses the existing Student-law definition rather than a normal approximation.

role: conditioning information for the indexed marginal calibration
notes: Each marginal test may use different conditioning information.

role: conditional probability that a remaining group level falls in bin k
notes: The denominator conditions on being above the previous bin boundary.

role: finite conditional bin-count transition probability
notes: Product of three binomial count probabilities in the stated independent normal example.

role: surviving probability mass at a placed-count state
notes: Requires no earlier stopping failure and fewer than two designated rejections.

role: absorbed probability that both designated tests have been rejected
notes: The final exact finite sum is numerically evaluated using normal CDF values.

role: standardized treatment-control mean difference
notes: Nonpositive under the one-sided comparison null.

role: nonnegative marginal calibration-error bound
notes: The error contributions remain explicit in the family guarantee.

role: number of tested levels in a normal-mean group
notes: Group totals four at mean zero and four at mean six and two at mean three; distinct from observation sample sizes.

role: standardized centered treatment-control mean contrast
notes: A standard normal variable independent of the pooled residual sum under the stated normal model.
